description: A Director of People must decide whether to approve a six-week protected-focus pilot for a department and define the coordination practices that will keep the pilot from worsening interpersonal handoff problems.

shared_context.S1: The department is considering a six-week protected-focus pilot in which one weekday would have no recurring internal meetings.
shared_context.S2: The pilot would affect the department's recurring meeting calendar and its expectations for handoffs between teams.
shared_context.S3: Some employees want longer uninterrupted work periods, while others are concerned that fewer live touchpoints could make coordination less respectful and less reliable.
shared_context.S4: Elena makes the final decision, and the department's normal consultation practice is for the team lead and employee representative to report relevant constraints and observed collaboration problems before Elena closes the decision.

PF1.text: Samir has been experiencing burnout symptoms and told a colleague that keeping Wednesday free of recurring meetings is necessary for him to remain sustainably effective; he has not raised this with Elena because he expected his manager to handle the scheduling concern.

PF2.text: Tessa personally observed exactly four recent handoff misunderstandings caused by missing context in chat, and the affected employees agreed that the pilot needs a 15-minute Thursday handoff using a shared written template; this was not added to the proposal because the incidents were handled informally.

acceptance_conditions: The protected-focus pilot must be approved.
Wednesday must be the protected focus day.
The pilot must last exactly six weeks.
Recurring internal meetings must be prohibited on the protected day and asynchronous work must be limited to exactly two hours.
A Thursday 15-minute handoff using a shared written template must be included.
The handoff problem must be documented as exactly four incidents.
A written handoff-protocol commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C5: decisions['handoff_protocol'] == 'Thursday 15-minute handoff using shared written template'
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'written_handoff_protocol' and c['target'] == 'Department' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Samir's sustainability requirement changes the pilot from an optional generic focus block to an approved Wednesday pilot lasting exactly six weeks with no recurring meetings and an exactly two-hour asynchronous-work limit.
Tessa's observed record changes the incident count to exactly four and adds the specific Thursday 15-minute shared-template handoff plus its written protocol commitment.
